memory_candidates.content: state-write.sh --audit-verdict passes the whole slurped evidence file as ONE --argjson argv, so the bound is MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KB) on the file's total size, not per line. For a multi-proposal audit, generate one single-line slice per proposal (from the committed condensed NDJSON) in the scratchpad and pass each slice to its own --allocate-into filing call; the gate matches on .proposal.id and records only the matching verdict object.

update-task-status.sh --depends-on-add requires an operation:target_status pair that is a status no-op, and map_status() has no pair resolving to not_started, so an edge cannot be added to a not_started task through it (orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh's resolve_noop_token() documents the gap). Append the edge via state-write.sh under the mutex with an append-only filter on .dependencies (unique), then run validate-state.sh for the Kahn cycle check.

In a deployed-only repository (no agent-system/ directory, no source_dir in .claude-extensions.json), every test suite that resolves its subject with common_test_resolve_subject in 'source-store' mode exits 2 'not found (mode=source-store)' regardless of content (observed: test-roadmap-generation.sh, test-generate-task-order.sh, test-update-task-status.sh). Treat these as environment failures: use a substitute check (e.g. roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate --dry-run) and record a Reasoned Exclusion rather than parking the phase PARTIAL.
